First, we rewrite the radicals as fractional exponents:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\sqrt{y}}{\sqrt[3]{y}}=\frac{{y}^{1/2}}{{y}^{1/3}}\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we apply the quotient rule:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{{y}^{1/2}}{{y}^{1/3}} & = \\ {y}^{1/2-1/3} & = \\ {y}^{3/6-2/6} & = \\ {y}^{1/6}\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we express the result as a radical:

$$
\begin{aligned}{y}^{1/6}=\sqrt[6]{y}\end{aligned}
$$
